2610.12172.title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
2610.12172.paper_summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.
2610.12172.paper_summary_zh: 學習行動如何改變場景幾何可以為以目標為導向的操作提供補充監督。<lb/>我們介紹了空間語言建模，它用離散坐標和語義標記的共享詞彙來表示場景輪廓、目標、行動目標和未來狀態。<lb/>一個特定任務的語法將這些元素組織成空間序列，允許一個自回歸的Transformer通過共同的下一標記目標來學習行動生成和行動條件狀態預測。<lb/>我們從零開始訓練模型，使用隨機遊玩過渡預訓練，然後在專家示範上進行聯合行動和狀態訓練。<lb/>在預訓練期間，記錄的行動坐標會影響後續的狀態預測，並且不包含在預測損失中。<lb/>在控制期間，模型僅解碼可執行的行動目標，並用新觀察到的狀態更新其歷史。<lb/>我們在模擬的Push-T和真實機器人上評估該方法。<lb/>該模型在模擬中達到了競爭性能，並且在任務成功率和目標覆蓋率上超過了評估的真實機器人策略基準。<lb/>訓練消融實驗顯示，聯合行動和狀態序列改善了控制，隨機遊玩預訓練則進一步提高了性能。<lb/>給定提供的行動軌跡，該模型還能預測連續的場景狀態，捕捉推動的幾何效應。
